template_data.headline_html: Four numbers that silently kill your GSA margins.

items.title: MFC pricing skipped
items.desc: GSA needs your best commercial rate. Quote a higher number and the CO finds it in negotiations — every time.

items.title: IFF not baked in
items.desc: The 0.75% Industrial Funding Fee comes off every award automatically. Miss it and it eats margin for the contract's life.

items.title: No EPA ceiling
items.desc: Rates lock in at award. Without an escalation clause, inflation quietly closes your margin over five years.

items.title: One CLIN for everything
items.desc: COs shop by labor category. Bundle mixed skills under one rate and you lose every RFQ that needs a cheaper option.
